statements.statement: Proposed FY25 budget timeline: requests due November 20, first presentation January 17, final presentation and hearing March 20, annual town meeting May 4.

warnings.prediction: Funding is going away and not all staff positions can be kept; very difficult decisions ahead.
This will not be as easy a budget year as the last two or three.

warning: EXTRACTED BY A LANGUAGE MODEL FROM MACHINE CAPTIONS. Every figure is as heard and may be misheard; every line carries the second in the video, which is the record.
